playwrightContext.notes: The app uses an in-memory SQLite database with seeded doctor data. Each test run starts fresh.

globalPrinciples.description: Patient data must be handled correctly at all times. No data loss, no incorrect associations.
Appointments must be consistent: no double-bookings, no assignments to unavailable doctors.

patient-registration.userGoal: Register a new patient with required personal information.
mustHold: Required fields (first name, last name, DOB) are validated before submission
Patient data persists and is visible in the patient list after registration
Validation errors are displayed clearly and allow correction
conceptualReviewQuestions: Does the registration form capture all medically required fields?
Is the patient immediately usable for appointments after registration?
commonFailureModes: Form accepted with missing required fields
Patient created but not visible in list
Validation error does not preserve entered data

executionHints.expectedOutcome: Patient appears in patient list with correct data.

appointment-booking.userGoal: Book an appointment for a registered patient with an available doctor.
mustHold: Only registered patients can book appointments
Double-booking the same doctor at the same time is prevented
Appointment appears in the appointment list with correct status
conceptualReviewQuestions: Can a patient book multiple appointments on the same day?
What happens when all doctors are busy at the requested time?

executionHints.expectedOutcome: Appointment appears in list with status 'scheduled'.

doctor-assignment.userGoal: Assign an available doctor to a patient and manage doctor availability.
mustHold: Only available doctors can be assigned to patients
Doctor availability can be toggled by authorized users
Assignment creates a valid appointment record
conceptualReviewQuestions: Should toggling availability cancel existing future appointments?
Can a doctor be assigned to a patient they are already seeing?
commonFailureModes: Availability toggle does not take effect immediately
Assignment does not create appointment record

executionHints.expectedOutcome: Doctor is assigned and appointment record is created.
